launch_xm_experiment: launch an XManager experiment that packages and runs CIFAR10 training on Kubernetes multi-worker
create_python_container: create a PythonContainer spec with base image, entrypoint module, and package path for XManager
package_executable: package an executable with PythonContainer spec, Kubernetes executor, and arguments via experiment.package
build_multiworker_strategy: build a MultiWorkerMirroredStrategyBuilder for distributed TensorFlow training on Kubernetes with GPU requirements
add_job_group_trials: add job group trials with hyperparameter variations to an XManager experiment
